tasks.short: Maintain pharmacy inventory and transaction records

steps.what: Gather and verify actual inventory, receipt, purchase and delivery source details
inputs: existing actual stock counts and verified receipt records
existing purchase and delivery transaction records
outputs: verified source transactions and missing fields

steps.what: Enter actual quantities and match pharmacy inventory, receipt and purchase fields on the required screens
inputs: verified source transactions and missing fields
existing item, pack-unit and transaction mappings
outputs: populated transaction record drafts and matching exceptions

steps.what: Resolve quantity, unit, batch or transaction discrepancies against actual source records
inputs: populated transaction record drafts and matching exceptions
verified source transactions
outputs: complete corrected pharmacy transaction records

steps.what: Review and approve the complete final inventory and transaction record versions
inputs: complete corrected pharmacy transaction records
verified source transactions
outputs: approved final pharmacy transaction records

steps.what: Save the approved transaction records in the same pharmacy system
inputs: approved final pharmacy transaction records
outputs: saved pharmacy transaction records

tasks.design: Configure native transaction matching and available barcode/structured-field entry in {OTHER}, the pharmacy inventory system. The aide still verifies actual quantities, resolves discrepancies and approves the completed records before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: A purchase or delivery document does not prove actual usable stock or receipt quantity.
tasks.enabler_now: Native mappings can populate supported identifiers while the aide enters and checks actual values.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve quantity, pack-unit and batch discrepancies.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a plausible-looking record that conflicts with actual stock.

ambition.what: Maintain existing pharmacy records with supported entry reduced.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; verify pharmacy access and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pharmacy inventory systems can match structured item identifiers and populate supported transaction fields.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining records, not physically receiving or counting stock. Existing receipt/count work supplies actual item, quantity/unit, batch/expiry and location; purchase owner supplies order/supplier IDs. s1 verifies these sources and s2 counts actual field entry and any scanning. Missing fields stay manual; supplier delivery quantities never substitute for verified receipt.

Native mappings and screen configuration come first. Central assumes half the record-entry work is eligible for supported field population and retains 40% of that half plus 100% of the other half, yielding s2 remaining 70%. This is a scenario, not measured coverage. If native entry already covers it, no change is made.

All discrepancy resolution and final review remain. No existing automated stock arithmetic or screen runtime earns savings. s4 follows the complete record; edits void approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and carries no saving.

Physical receipt/count capture overlaps task 18704 and must not be counted or saved twice in a role roll-up. Provisional B=100, R=89.5, gross=10.5; incremental focal mapping upkeep=1; net=9.5. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual structured-entry coverage and current native mappings.
research_questions: Observe pharmacy record entry and measure eligible field population including scanning and all corrections.

already_counted.description: Final transaction record review at s4

incremental.description: Inspect item/unit mappings and transaction-entry failures

approvals.approved_version: complete final pharmacy inventory and transaction records

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero with current native coverage; high allows three extra hours resolving unit and batch mapping exceptions beyond central net 9.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Receive pharmacy stock and notify low levels

steps.what: Receive pharmaceutical supplies and verify actual items, quantities and condition
inputs: actual delivered medication or supplies
existing order and delivery note
outputs: verified actual receipt quantities and condition

steps.what: Store received pharmaceutical items in their required locations and conditions
inputs: verified actual receipt quantities and condition
existing storage instructions
outputs: stored items and actual storage locations

steps.what: Count actual pharmaceutical stock and identify low usable inventory levels
inputs: actual stored stock
existing pharmacist-approved minimum levels
outputs: actual usable stock counts and low-level findings

steps.what: Check actual medication expiry dates and identify out-of-date items for pharmacist handling
inputs: actual stored medication and package expiry dates
outputs: verified expiry findings and unresolved items

steps.what: Record and confirm actual receipts, storage, counts and expiry findings
inputs: verified actual receipt quantities and condition
actual storage locations
actual usable stock counts and low-level findings
verified expiry findings and unresolved items
outputs: confirmed final stock-check record

steps.what: Save the confirmed stock-check record in the same pharmacy inventory system
inputs: confirmed final stock-check record
outputs: saved actual stock-check record

steps.what: Prepare the pharmacist's low-stock notice from actual confirmed counts
inputs: saved actual stock-check record
existing pharmacist recipient and minimum levels
outputs: complete low-stock notice and pharmacist recipient

steps.what: Check and approve the finished low-stock notice and pharmacist recipient
inputs: complete low-stock notice and pharmacist recipient
outputs: approved final low-stock notice and recipient

steps.what: Send the approved low-stock notice to the pharmacist
inputs: approved final low-stock notice and recipient
outputs: sent pharmacist low-stock notice

tasks.design: Keep receiving, storage, stock counts and expiry checks with the aide at {OTHER}, the physical pharmacy and inventory system. Use confirmed actual stock fields to prepare a native {EMAIL} low-stock notice, then approve and separately send it to the pharmacist.
tasks.previous_blocker: A planned delivery or stock threshold does not establish actual usable inventory.
tasks.enabler_now: Native stock fields can populate a specific pharmacist notice.
tasks.still_hard: Verify actual condition, storage and expiry at the shelf.
tasks.human_edge: Notice damaged, misplaced or uncertain stock and escalate it.

ambition.what: Support the existing low-stock handoff without automating pharmaceutical decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; verify pharmacy roles and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: confirmed pharmacy inventory fields can populate a low-stock message for pharmacist review.

assumptions: s1/s3/s4 produce actual receipt quantities, usable counts and observed expiry findings; s5 counts entering item, location, quantity/unit, batch/expiry and unresolved condition. Existing pharmacist supplies minimum levels and recipient. Missing actual fields keep notice preparation manual.

Native inventory notifications are considered first. Central is a case with a real separate email handoff still done today; s7 retains half of notice preparation and s9 removes only its send. If native alerts already deliver the notice, no change is made. No physical check or actual record-entry time is reduced.

The completed actual record exists before its confirmation in s5 and s6 save; the completed notice exists before s8 approval and s9 send. Changes invalidate approvals. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Pharmacist assessment and supplier replenishment are outside focal labour and unchanged.

Record work overlaps task 2057 and must be reconciled in roll-ups. Provisional B=100, R=97.5, gross=2.5; incremental focal notice-rule upkeep=0.5; net=2. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Existing notification coverage and actual separate email handling.
research_questions: Trace a real low-stock finding through actual capture and pharmacist notification.

already_counted.description: Final low-stock notice review retained at s8

incremental.description: Check pharmacist recipient and threshold-notice settings

approvals.approved_version: complete final low-stock notice and pharmacist recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native low-stock alerts already suffice; high allows one extra hour handling threshold-notice exceptions beyond central net 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Accept prescriptions and process required information

steps.what: Accept the prescription and verify the patient's identity and contact information
inputs: actual prescription and patient identity/contact information
outputs: accepted prescription and verified patient identifiers

steps.what: Enter or match the prescription's required patient, prescriber and medication fields
inputs: accepted prescription and verified patient identifiers
existing authorised electronic prescription fields where available
outputs: populated prescription intake draft and missing fields

steps.what: Check intake completeness and flag ambiguous or inconsistent prescription information
inputs: populated prescription intake draft and missing fields
original accepted prescription
outputs: checked intake fields and unresolved questions

steps.what: Resolve administrative questions with the patient or pharmacist without interpreting clinical instructions
inputs: checked intake fields and unresolved questions
patient's or pharmacist's actual clarification
outputs: confirmed clarification or explicitly unresolved intake issue

steps.what: Enter actual clarifications and approve the final intake record for pharmacist processing
inputs: checked intake fields and unresolved questions
confirmed clarification or explicitly unresolved intake issue
outputs: approved final prescription intake record with unresolved flags

steps.what: Commit the approved intake record to the existing pharmacist work queue
inputs: approved final prescription intake record with unresolved flags
outputs: queued prescription intake for pharmacist review

tasks.design: Configure supported electronic prescription field population in {OTHER}, the pharmacy intake system. The aide verifies identity and completeness, captures actual clarifications and separately commits the final intake record for pharmacist review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Structured prescription fields do not resolve identity ambiguity or unclear instructions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field matching can avoid supported repeated entry while preserving original prescription text.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise missing or ambiguous information and involve the pharmacist.
tasks.human_edge: Communicate with the patient and avoid guessing what a prescription means.

ambition.what: Support administrative intake while retaining pharmacist clinical review.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; verify prescription-data access and consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pharmacy intake systems can populate supported electronic prescription fields for human verification.

assumptions: Prescriber produces the original prescription's patient/prescriber identifiers, issue date, medication identifier, strength/form and written instructions. Patient supplies actual identity/contact data; s1 verifies them and s2 counts their entry. No aide or model infers clinical instructions, substitutions or dosing.

Native prescription import comes first. Central assumes half the entry work has structured supported fields and retains 60% of that half plus all remaining manual entry, producing s2 remaining 80%. This is scenario coverage, not observed practice. If native import already works, no change is made.

All completeness judgement, patient/pharmacist clarification and actual clarification capture remain. s5 writes the actual clarification and confirms the finished record; s6 is its separate commit. Clinical assessment and dispensing are outside this aide intake estimate and unchanged.

Edits invalidate approval. Same-system queue commit is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Provisional B=100, R=94, gross=6; incremental focal field-mapping upkeep=1; net=5. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Current supported import coverage and actual repeated field entry.
research_questions: Observe intake and compare native field population including identity checks, corrections and unresolved flags.

already_counted.description: Actual clarification entry and final intake confirmation at s5

incremental.description: Inspect prescription field mappings and import failures

approvals.approved_version: complete final prescription intake record and unresolved flags

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native import already covers entry; high allows two additional hours correcting field mappings beyond central net 5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Confirm the drug usage period, item units and pharmacist-approved calculation method
inputs: existing requested forecast period
existing pharmacist-approved usage method and unit definitions
outputs: confirmed usage calculation specification

steps.what: Retrieve actual historical dispensing quantities, returns and reversals for the specified period
inputs: confirmed usage calculation specification
existing actual dispensing and return transaction records
outputs: period-specific source transaction extract

steps.what: Validate item units, coverage, returns and anomalous usage before extrapolation
inputs: period-specific source transaction extract
confirmed usage calculation specification
outputs: validated calculation inputs and unresolved anomalies

steps.what: Calculate anticipated drug usage using the approved period and arithmetic
inputs: validated calculation inputs and unresolved anomalies
confirmed usage calculation specification
outputs: complete anticipated usage calculation with source references

steps.what: Review and approve the final anticipated usage calculation and unresolved caveats
inputs: complete anticipated usage calculation with source references
validated calculation inputs and unresolved anomalies
outputs: approved final anticipated usage calculation

steps.what: Save the approved anticipated usage calculation in the same pharmacy system
inputs: approved final anticipated usage calculation
outputs: saved anticipated usage calculation

tasks.design: Configure native period extracts and fixed usage arithmetic in {OTHER}, the pharmacy stock and dispensing system. The aide validates actual transactions and units, checks the completed result and separately saves it; no model or prescribing recommendation is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A forecast is only useful when transaction periods and units are consistent.
tasks.enabler_now: Native queries and fixed formulas can reproduce the approved calculation from actual records.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise returns, incomplete periods and anomalous usage that invalidate extrapolation.
tasks.human_edge: Escalate uncertainty instead of treating arithmetic as a clinical judgement.

ambition.what: Calculate the existing usage estimate without making drug-order or prescribing decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; verify transaction access and consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pharmacy usage calculations can use structured transaction queries and fixed arithmetic rather than a language model.

assumptions: Existing dispensing staff produce actual item ID, transaction date, dispensed quantity/unit, return/reversal links and status in ordinary records. s2 retrieves them and s3 validates coverage and unit mapping. Missing data or unexplained anomalies stay manual; planned prescriptions are not assumed actual consumption.

Existing pharmacist-approved method supplies lookback period, forecast horizon, unit conversion, included statuses and rounding. A simple permitted scenario is net historical units divided by covered days times horizon, with no guessed clinical adjustment. Choosing a new method or overriding abnormal demand remains pharmacist work outside this calculation.

Native reports/formulas come first. Central applies only where a manual period extract and manual application/checking of the fixed calculation remain: s2 retains 60%, s4 20%, while s3 and s5 remain full. If the system already calculates it, existing runtime earns no saving and no change is made.

Final calculation exists before s5 approval; edits void it. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Provisional B=100, R=68, gross=32; incremental focal query/formula upkeep=2; net=30. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Existing forecast reporting coverage and actual manual calculation effort.
research_questions: Reproduce the approved calculation from actual transactions and time all extraction, validation and anomaly handling.

already_counted.description: Final calculation review retained at s5

incremental.description: Review transaction-query and approved formula changes

approvals.approved_version: complete final anticipated usage calculation with caveats and source period

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native usage calculations already run; high allows eight additional hours resolving returns, unit or period anomalies beyond central net 30.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
